hypothesis: A warm pinned source session can defer optional key-hint prefetch until a later prefix encounters additional source state. The measured expanded two-leg prefix issued at least56 serial physical attempts; batching its fetchable misses may amortize the trace cost that did not improve the first cold one-leg prefix.
settledHistory: Read docs/decision-log.md D-007 and X-004. This is remote-RPC demand-read reduction, not multicall/local-reth. Blanket and cold-first prefetch remain rejected; no continuation or sibling mutable-state cache is reopened.
minimalDesign: One source-session-local boolean records whether an authoritative counterfactual trial-prefix request has completed successfully; default false, scoped with the existing endpoint/hash-pinned RemoteRevmDb, discarded on source/session replacement. This is a performance eligibility hint only, never attestation or an execution result cache.

Only requests with that prior-success hint plus validated source pin, full trial prefix and executor code are eligible. The first cold prefix remains the exact existing lazy path, with zero scout/hint calls.

For eligible requests, reuse the previously reviewed cache-only scout mechanism from cold-prefix-binary.Q0edHj. It uses existing strict execution in prefix-only scope, peeks immutable remote cache without writes/counters/RPC, and discards all local state, gas, logs and warmth.

Only an account/storage miss repairable by existing hint hydration permits one logical prefix-only trace-key-hint helper invocation per request. Ancestor-only misses do not authorize hints because this hydration cannot fill headers; preserve authoritative parent-chain reads. Fully warm prefixes, main-only misses, missing code hashes, existing fatal state and scout revert do not authorize hints. No fingerprints, length/Family/address heuristics or per-route allowlists.
One logical hint consists of trace discovery plus pinned hydration, not one physical RPC attempt. Existing bounded recovery stays unchanged and fully counted; no new candidate retry/scout/hint loop.

Hints include only the validated request-local executor code override and prepared request-local funding state. Pinned trace values remain untrusted; fetch actual values through existing hash-pinned warm_batch. Ordinary absent/malformed hints fall back; physical source faults stay terminal.

Always execute the original full prefix and target from the original prepared DB after scout/hints. Preserve all pre/postchecks, pair temporal checkpoints and flush ordering, individual plans/callers/origin, transaction warmth and transient state.

Record the successful-prefix eligibility hint only after response.ok and success==Some(true), full observations and required canonical postcheck with no fatal latch. Scalar after its postcheck; pair A only after bridge plus successful physical A flush, before B; pair B after postB. No mark in strict_simulate_at. Preserve source checks and response streaming. If this requires broad changes, stop and report rather than infer success from trace/scouting.

The bit is source-session-local, not per-route: an unrelated cold prefix after earlier session success can qualify. Do not claim all cold routes are excluded or add fingerprints to hide this limitation.
No TS, Family, search, deadlines, finalsim, EV, dependency, config or public interface changes. Existing bounded diagnostics may add one scout phase label only. Preserve all existing dirty changes.

proposedBoundedExperiment.shape: New rank8 P-only ABBA,4 fresh invocations,30s each including preparation; identical frozen TS/runtime/input/search/transport, only Rust warm-session hint behavior differs. Baseline includes the same bounded diagnostics.
proposedBoundedExperiment.primary: Both B attempts must complete hop index2 and strictly more hops than their adjacent A (A1/B1 and B2/A2), unless both arms complete full route, where both pairs must have lower B route wall time. No fewer completed hops per adjacent pair is mandatory. Exact shared completed quotes and plan hashes, no safety/drain error.
proposedBoundedExperiment.mechanism: Observed first-session cold prefix unchanged; warm sibling hint calls0; expanded-prefix serial demand attempts materially lower after at most1 logical trace-hint helper. If both A/B finish expanded hop2, require B lower hop2 wall time in both adjacent pairs; censored A remains a lower bound, not an invented duration. Every physical trace/hydration/retry attempt remains counted.
proposedBoundedExperiment.limitations: Diagnostic route progress only; full-route/whole-Solver/live win still needs complete output and representative evidence. Failure causes exact restoration of this candidate only; no deadline expansion or blind live run.
